thread:
Jin (Acme): hitting urgent errors from our rerank pipeline since ~08:20 UTC.  All rerank calls that used to work are now returning a 410 / model_deprecated error.  Example response below. This is impacting search ranking in prod

Sofia (Support): sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact request you're sending (redact sensitive text) and the full error response? also which model id are you calling?

Jin (Acme): here's the curl and response. model id we used: `rerank-legacy-2022`

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \   -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \   -d '{"model":"rerank-legacy-2022","query":"best screwdriver for electricians","candidates":["a 6-inch screwdriver","electrician's kit","cordless drill"]}'
```

Response: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "model_deprecated",
    "message": "model 'rerank-legacy-2022' has been deprecated and removed from the public catalog. If you have a Dedicated/Private installation, please contact support.",
    "code": 410
  },
  "request_id": "req_01EXAMPLE123"
}
```

Jin (Acme): we just started seeing this after a deploy yesterday, not sure if we were pinned to an alias that expired.  Can you help with migration?

Sofia (Support): thanks — two things: 1) if you were relying on a public alias that was retired, you should migrate to `rerank-2024-v1`. 2) in some cases the SDK auto-resolves aliases; if you pinned the exact id `rerank-legacy-2022` it won't redirect. Can you try the new id and share results? also what's the SDK / REST path you use in prod?

Jin (Acme): we're using direct REST (no SDK). tried `rerank-2024-v1` and got a 200 but the scores look wrong — every candidate gets the same score (0.5) which is not expected. payload below (only model changed).

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{"model":"rerank-2024-v1","query":"best screwdriver for electricians","candidates":"a 6-inch screwdriver"}'
```

Response: 
```json
{
  "model": "rerank-2024-v1",
  "scores": [0.5],
  "request_id": "req_01EXAMPLE456"
}
```

Jin (Acme): we changed only the model id and got that. If we pass three candidates we still get identical scores like `[0.5,0.5,0.5]`.

Sofia (Support): that looks like an input formatting issue: I see you sent `candidates` as a string in the second curl. The rerank API expects `candidates` to be an array of strings. If the payload shape is wrong we sometimes return a fallback uniform scoring instead of a hard error. Can you paste the exact raw JSON you sent when you see three identical scores?

Jin (Acme): sorry, here is raw JSON we sent (we thought our client serialized the array correctly):

```json
{"model":"rerank-2024-v1","query":"best screwdriver for electricians","candidates":["a 6-inch screwdriver","electrician's kit","cordless drill"]}
```

Jin (Acme): sending that still returns identical scores. we also double-checked Content-Type header is `application/json` and no proxies mutate body.

Kai (ML): jumping in — two orthogonal issues here: 1) deprecation/alias behavior for `rerank-legacy-2022`, and 2) identical scores for properly shaped payloads. For (1) we removed that legacy model and didn't add a permanent alias; we should have provided clearer guidance. For (2) identical scores often happen if the model's context window is exceeded or if candidates are deduped client-side into one entry before scoring. A few quick checks: are any candidate strings extremely long? is `sequence_limit` being hit? do you send `max_candidates` or any rerank params?

Jin (Acme): candidates are short. no long docs. we do sometimes pass 120 candidates in other flows but tried with 3 in this repro and still see identical scores. no special params.

Eli (Eng-Oncall): looking at logs for request_id `req_01EXAMPLE456` — on our side the request reached the rerank service and the model runner returned a uniform vector. attaching trimmed logs: `runner: effective_candidates=3, kv_cache_hits=0, truncation=0, fallback_uniform_score=true`

Eli (Eng-Oncall): it seems the runner triggered a fallback scoring path because the model binary for `rerank-2024-v1` was in a degraded state on the node that handled that request. we have a mitigation: a hotfix that avoids silent uniform fallbacks and instead returns a 5xx with `score_service_degraded` so callers won't assume valid scores. I'm deploying the hotfix to canary now.

Kai (ML): also adding: we will add a stricter validation for `candidates` length and emit `bad_payload` if it isn't an array; that will prevent the subtle uniform fallback case. For the deprecated alias issue, product will create redirect mappings for all public legacy models for a 30-day window and send notices.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for `rerank-runner` patch (deploy/7891) — targeting 10% of traffic.

Eli (Eng-Oncall): canary shows reduced uniform fallback. I'm routing Jin's tenant away from the flaky node and created a temporary alias mapping: `rerank-legacy-2022` -> `rerank-2024-v1` for your tenant id `acme-42`. This is a temporary per-tenant alias until the customer migrates.

Jin (Acme): confirming — after retry with the mapped alias I now get varied scores: `[0.86, 0.12, 0.02]`. that looks correct. thanks.

Sofia (Support): great — final action items: 1) Kai/Product: create public alias redirects for legacy rerank ids (30 days) and add deprecation notices to changelog; 2) Kai/Eng: add stricter input validation to return `bad_payload` for non-array `candidates`; 3) Eli/Eng: ship the hotfix to stop silent uniform fallbacks and return an explicit 5xx that will trigger retries; 4) Support: reach out to affected customers with migration steps and example payloads.

Kai (ML): noted — will open follow-up PRs and share timeline.

Eli (Eng-Oncall): will promote rollout to 100% in 20m if canary stays green.

Jin (Acme): appreciate the quick help and the per-tenant alias. please send the migration doc and example curl for our deploy checklist.

Sofia (Support): sending migration doc and example payload now: https://redwood.internal/docs/migrate-rerank-legacy -> includes example: `{"model":"rerank-2024-v1","query":"...","candidates":["...","..."]}` and SDK tips. Marking this thread resolved once you confirm stable in 24h. :white_check_mark:
